name: Textile Waste Supply Co. Wiping Products
old_description: Since the days of horse-drawn carts Textile Waste Supply has been providing America's industries with the best wiping and polishing materials while promoting a focus on recycling and efficiency.
about:
Textile Waste Supply Company has operated from Charlestown, Massachusetts since 1922. The business remains family owned and operated, tracing its roots to the era of horse-drawn carts when it began supplying wiping and polishing materials to American industry.

The company produces wiping cloths, with over 90 percent of its stock made from reclaimed and recycled textiles. The materials undergo washing and drying cycles that yield low-lint, highly absorbent cloths. The operation ships worldwide, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Textile Waste Supply serves a broad range of industrial customers, offering wiping solutions for all industries. No specific sectors or client names are provided in the available information.

The company emphasizes recycling and efficiency, positioning its recycled wiping cloths as cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternatives. Its stated goal is 100 percent user satisfaction through quality, consistency, and value.
